mathematical_reconciliation_of_57_92_per.numerator_definition: Products exhibiting an isolated anomaly in exactly 1 modality, suppressed from high-risk elevation
mathematical_reconciliation_of_57_92_per.denominator_definition: Total single-modality candidate anomaly flags across all modalities (reviews + pricing + images)
mathematical_reconciliation_of_57_92_per.critical_scientific_distinction: The 57.92% metric represents the proportion of isolated single-modality anomaly flags that the Multimodal Evidence Engine suppresses from false escalation to ELEVATED_MULTIMODAL_ANOMALY. It must NOT be reported as a ground-truth false-positive rate measured against legal fraud verdicts, because zero verified external fraud verdicts exist in the catalog. It is strictly an architectural isolated-noise suppression rate.

policy_1_single_modality_naive.description: Any single anomaly (e.g. promotional review, price variation, stock image) triggers HIGH risk.
policy_1_single_modality_naive.flaw: Severe false accusation: falsely penalizes 413 benign sellers due to legitimate price promos or templated reviews.

policy_2_multimodal_corroboration_requir.description: High risk strictly requires corroboration across >=2 independent modalities (v1.7 production).
policy_2_multimodal_corroboration_requir.advantage: Suppresses 413 isolated alarms (57.92% of candidate flags), protecting innocent sellers while isolating high-risk products.
